script_text:
Stop! Aries, the stars are screaming at your Fire element right now.

Neptune is stationing retrograde in your 1st House of Self, clouding your identity with doubt and illusion. Your ruling planet Mars in Virgo squares Uranus in your 3rd House of Communication, triggering impulsive speech and work disruptions. The Sun in Scorpio lights up your 8th House of Intimacy, forcing hidden emotions to the surface.

If you are taken, expect a power struggle over shared finances or secrets. If you are single, you will attract a mysterious Scorpio type who sees through your bold facade.

Mars forms a trine to Pluto in your 10th House of Career, giving you dominance over rivals and a chance to reshape your ambitions. Jupiter in your 4th House of Home warns against mixing family loans with business decisions.

Avoid signing any contracts until Mercury clears its shadow period.

Follow for tomorrow's reading.
